_note: Config for tools/build-demo.mjs. Run from the repo root: node tools/build-demo.mjs demos/facts-directory/build.json. Previously this demo had no checked-in config, so a rebuild was guesswork — that is why it drifted behind the app. The source Index.html is a COMPLETE document (unlike transportation's fragment), so no wrapper replacement is needed; build-demo.mjs injects the demo shim before </head> and inlines SearchClient (the browser copy of Search.gs) via includeDir. Each replacement below reproduces what doGet supplies at runtime. ATHLETICS_ON is forced on: the feature is paused in production only because no athletics rosters are loaded in FACTS yet, and a showcase should demonstrate the code, not mirror a data gap.
replace: var ATHLETICS_ON = true; // demo: always on (production gates this on ATHLETICS_ENABLED)
